title: Phase 55H makes the Toronto Council and enactment gates explicit
summary: FTFN refreshed Toronto application 24 254930 before its July 29-31 Council window. The official item history now supplies a dated Council gate and identifies wind-study, land-exchange, and laneway conditions that must be cleared before the amendment bills can be enacted. Full-address building-permit searches remain bounded negative results.
evidence_note: The official record schedules Council consideration but does not establish a Council disposition or enacted by-laws. Application Not Found markers across the eight project addresses are negative portal-query results, not proof that no building permit exists.
